answer_2.quote: We report Coding score as the average of pass@1 of HumanEval and MBPP; Math score as the average of top-1 accuracy of 8-shot GSM8K and 4-shot MATH; OpenQA score as the average of 5-shot performance on NaturalQuestions and TriviaQA; ... we use ROUGE, F1 and Exact Match for summarization and QA.
